name: SoChain
author: Atif Nazir
description: Look up a BTC, LTC, DOGE or ZEC address on SoChain: balance, totals, activity, recent counterparties and address poisoning. No API key required.

configurationItems.name: key
configurationItems.description: Optional SoChain API key from https://sochain.com/dashboard. Without one, lookups work up to 2,500 a day per IP.
